in_marathi.name: Vedika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vedika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vedika means 'knowledge' or 'wisdom' in Sanskrit. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ved', which means 'knowledge'. Vedika is a name of a goddess in Hinduism and is believed to symbolize knowledge, wisdom, and light. This name is also associated with the natural world and is often given to children born during the spring season.
